label: Past Continuous
outcome: Lo studente costruisce e usa il Past Continuous per descrivere un'azione in corso in un momento passato o come sfondo di una scena, incluse domande e negative.
must_master: action in progress at a past time
background action in a past scene
questions with was/were before the subject
basic -ing spelling already known from Present Continuous
do_not_teach_yet: full Past Simple vs Past Continuous contrast
when/while as a mechanical tense-selection rule

italian_learner_risks.risk: using the base verb after was/were
using did in Past Continuous questions

context_bank: what people were doing at a specific time yesterday
background actions in a photo-like past scene
school evening routines at a past moment
phone calls asking what someone was doing
weather and surrounding actions in a short story
quality_rejections: a worksheet solvable only from at 8 o'clock
mixing in a full Past Simple contrast lesson
more than two consecutive near-identical gap fills
ambiguous past contexts where a simple past reading is equally intended
